strategies_investigated.description: Files present in corrective commit but not modified by candidate
strategies_investigated.name: unaffected_in_corrective
strategies_investigated.reason: Being unchanged by a corrective commit does not mean the file is defect-free. It may be indirectly affected.

strategies_investigated.description: Files surviving long observation without corrective event
strategies_investigated.name: long_observation_window
strategies_investigated.reason: Absence of observed corrective event is not evidence of absence of defect. Censoring is informative.

strategies_investigated.description: Files modified many times without corrective evidence
strategies_investigated.name: repeated_modification
strategies_investigated.reason: Frequent modification without observed correction may indicate a high-risk file, not a safe one.
